structured_output.title: Let's Encrypt account key label: issuer usage not visible
structured_output.content: The change adds the label app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: cert-manager to the account key Secrets that cert-manager creates for Let's Encrypt (ACME) accounts. The environment summary shows only a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD. It shows no Issuer or ClusterIssuer CRD or manifest, so we can't tell whether an ACME issuer is used. Check whether any ACME Issuer or ClusterIssuer exists in the cluster. If one does, check whether any tooling, policy or selector acts on that label for account key Secrets.
